nodes.label: API Gateway
nodes.about: The single front door: authenticates and routes requests to the booking service, retrying once on failure.

nodes.label: Booking service
nodes.about: Locks the seat, charges the card and checks for fraud at the same time, saves the booking, then queues the confirmation email.
nodes.when_down: The gateway retries once, then returns 502.

nodes.label: Payment service
nodes.about: Charges the card through the card network.
nodes.when_down: The booking releases its seat lock and fails, so the seat is free for someone else.

nodes.label: Card network
nodes.about: An outside service: we only see whether it approves.

nodes.label: Fraud check
nodes.about: Blocks a seat after too many booking attempts, using a counter in Redis.
nodes.when_down: Bookings fail: the business chose to refuse payments it can't check.

nodes.label: Redis
nodes.about: Holds a lock per seat (SETNX) so two people can't buy the same seat, and the fraud counters.
nodes.when_down: No locks means no safe bookings, so every booking fails.

nodes.label: Bookings DB
nodes.when_down: Bookings fail after payment. A real system would refund or retry; this one just fails.

nodes.label: Email queue
nodes.about: Decouples email from booking: the booking finishes as soon as the message is queued.
nodes.when_down: The booking fails at the last step, because it can't hand over the email.

nodes.label: Mailer 1
nodes.about: Takes messages off the queue and sends the confirmation email.

nodes.label: Mailer 2
nodes.about: Takes messages off the queue and sends the confirmation email.

nodes.label: Email provider
nodes.when_down: Mailers fail and messages go back on the queue. Revive it and they are delivered.

error.say: Payment failed: release the seat lock

down.say: Payment service down: release the seat lock

charge.say: Payment service → Card network: authorize the charge

send_email.say: Mailer → Email provider: send the confirmation

scenarios.label: Seat already taken
scenarios.explain: The first booking holds the lock on 12A, so the second one stops at SETNX with 409 Conflict before anyone is charged.

scenarios.label: Mailers down
scenarios.explain: The booking still succeeds: email is async. The message waits in the queue; revive a mailer and watch it go out.

scenarios.label: Payment service down
scenarios.explain: The booking releases the seat lock and fails, so nothing is saved and the seat stays free.

scenarios.label: Redis is down
scenarios.explain: Without the lock there's no safe way to book, so the service refuses before charging anyone.
